eatmoreduck-boss-zhipin-scraper-root.description: Scrape BOSS直聘 (job listing site) via Chrome CDP. Searches jobs by keyword/city/filters, fetches JD details, outputs structured JSON/CSV with plaintext salary, and can summarize scraped results into a job-market prompt. Optional --company locally filters results by company name (boss_name substring) with no extra request. Use when user wants to search/analyze jobs on BOSS直聘 or zhipin.com.
eatmoreduck-boss-zhipin-scraper-root.author: eatmoreduck
